1. Agreement

SparkScribe is a product operated by HRstudios LLC. By creating an account or using SparkScribe you agree to these Terms and the Privacy Policy. If you use SparkScribe for an organisation, you confirm you may accept these Terms on its behalf.

Age. You must be at least 13 years old. If you are 13 to 17, you may use SparkScribe only with your parent's or guardian's permission, and a Plus or Pro subscription must be purchased by a parent, guardian or another adult, who agrees to these Terms for that purchase. Legal review

2. The service

SparkScribe turns audio and video files into transcripts in your browser (your audio isn't uploaded) and, if you choose, creates summaries, notes, study material and answers from the transcript text using AI. Saving transcripts and using AI features require an account. Features may change; we'll give notice of significant changes.

Transcription is English-only for now. Other languages may be transcribed poorly or not at all.

Fair-use limits. AI features have usage limits per account and a service-wide daily cap that protect the service's costs. When a limit is reached, the app tells you when you can continue. We may adjust limits; your plan's transcription allowance below is not affected by them.

3. Plans and subscriptions

  • Plans: Free ($0, 60 minutes of transcription a month), Plus ($7.99 a month, 20 hours) and Pro ($14.99 a month, 50 hours). Prices are in US dollars [plus applicable taxes] To confirm: tax handling.
  • What the allowance counts: the length of recordings you transcribe and save. AI features, exports and opening saved recordings don't use it. Free resets each calendar month; Plus and Pro reset at each renewal. Unused time doesn't carry over.
  • Payment and renewal: payments are handled by Stripe; we never see your full card details. Plus and Pro renew automatically every month on the same date until you cancel. You'll see the price and renewal terms before you pay.
  • Upgrades (Plus to Pro) take effect immediately; the prorated difference for the rest of the current period is charged at once.
  • Downgrades (Pro to Plus) take effect immediately; the unused part of the higher price is credited to your next payment. To confirm: keep immediate downgrades, or change to the end of the period
  • Cancellation: at any time in Plan & usage → Manage Billing. Your plan stays active until the end of the period you've paid for, then you return to Free and no further payments are taken. Nothing in your library is deleted.
  • Failed payments: if a renewal payment fails, Stripe retries it over about two weeks and we email you how to update your card; you keep your plan during that time. If payment still can't be collected, the subscription ends and you return to Free. To confirm: grace period
  • Refunds: [REFUND POLICY] To confirm: + LEGAL REVIEW. Duplicate charges and charges made after an account was deleted are refunded automatically.
  • Price changes: at least [30] days' notice by email before the renewal they apply to; you can cancel before then To confirm.
  • Deleting your account cancels any subscription immediately, so you are never charged again. [The unused part of the current period is not refunded.] To confirm

4. Your account

Keep your password secure and your email address current. You're responsible for activity in your account. You can delete your account at any time in Settings; deletion is immediate and permanent.

5. Your content

You keep all rights to your recordings, transcripts and the material created from them ("your content"). You give us permission to store, process and transmit your content only as needed to provide the service to you, including sending transcript text to our AI provider when you use AI features. We don't use your content to train AI models.

You're responsible for your content and for having the right to record, upload and transcribe it, including consent from the people recorded where the law, your school or your workplace requires it. Legal review

6. Acceptable use

Don't use SparkScribe to: break the law or others' rights (including privacy and recording-consent laws); record people secretly where that's unlawful; process content you aren't allowed to; attempt to access other accounts or our systems without permission; overload, scrape or reverse-engineer the service or get around plan allowances or usage limits (for example with many accounts or automated requests); or use AI features to create harmful, deceptive or illegal material. Anthropic's usage policy (https://www.anthropic.com/legal/aup) also applies to AI features.

7. AI output and transcription accuracy

AI-generated summaries, notes, quizzes, drafts and answers can be incomplete or wrong, and transcription can mishear words, names or speakers. Check important information against the recording before relying on it, especially for legal, medical, financial or academic decisions.

8. Availability and changes

We provide SparkScribe "as is" and "as available". We work to keep it running and your data safe, but we don't guarantee uninterrupted service, and AI features may be paused at busy times. Export anything you can't afford to lose. Legal review

9. Suspension and termination

We may suspend or close accounts that break these Terms or put the service or other users at risk; where reasonable, we'll tell you why first. You may stop using SparkScribe and delete your account at any time.
